references.title: From Self-Evolving Synthetic Data to Verifiable-Reward RL: Post-Training Multi-turn Interactive Tool-Using Agents

methodology.notes: AReaL-SEA is based on Qwen3-235B-Thinking-2507 and was post-trained using SFT followed by RL on data constructed from the tau2-bench domain. The model was not trained on the specific evaluation tasks themselves, but on synthetically constructed training scenarios within the same domain. Evaluation was conducted using the standard tau2-bench protocol.

verification.details: Verified evaluation with full trajectory data available.
